name: Jin Chan´s Pond of Riches
review:
Jin Chan's Pond of Riches is a 5x3, 15-line Asian slot with multiplier wilds and a bonus game where wins stick.

Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with a 10,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.27%.

During the bonus, wins stick in place, so multiplier wilds landing later can build on them. The serene golden-pond setting contrasts with its very high volatility.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
